DataStax Astra DB — database

astra/database · version 1

envs add astra/database

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
ASTRA_DB_APPLICATION_TOKEN required secret Application token. Carries the role it was created with.. Shape ^AstraCS:[A-Za-z0-9:]{20,}$. where to get it
ASTRA_DB_API_ENDPOINT required config Database endpoint. An address, not a credential.. Shape ^https://\S+$. where to get it
